section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from mediation model testing examining the relationships between online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) experiences, broad conceptualization of beauty, body appreciation, and intuitive eating. The analysis controlled for age, BMI, and time spent on QQ, and found that broad conceptualization of beauty partially mediated the relationship between OISO experiences and intuitive eating, while the direct path from OISO experiences to body appreciation was non-significant and removed from the final trimmed model.

section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the testing of a mediation model with a sample of 1152 participants (mean age 13.08 years, mean BMI 17.77). The analysis examined whether broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation mediated the relationship between online interpersonal sexual objectification experiences and intuitive eating. The correlation between body appreciation and BMI was -0.11 (p < .001).
